title: just-deliver catalog mapping
description: Turns a matching requirement into graph nodes. Selected by matching criteria, never by conditionals. Expressions (${...}) are kept as raw strings by the loader and evaluated later.

match.description: Criteria this mapping applies to. The more criteria that match, the more specific the mapping.

nodes.description: Graph nodes by name; the name is how other expressions refer to the node.

exports.description: Export name -> expression producing it. Must equal the type's exports exactly; a runtime mapping (kind: runtime) has none.

probe.description: Runtime mappings only: how to check the deployed runtime is healthy. The graph carries it on the runtime node.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to keep trying before the revision counts as unhealthy (grants may take minutes to propagate).

intervalSeconds.description: Wait between attempts; at most timeoutSeconds.

release.description: Runtime mappings only: which inputs and outputs of the runtime node's template the release flow (dark revision, grants, probe, traffic shift) uses. The engine sets the two inputs, so the runtime node must not.

suffixInput.description: Template input that receives the revision suffix.

trafficInput.description: Template input that receives the traffic list.

trafficOutput.description: Output echoing the traffic last deployed; names the live revision.

revisionOutput.description: Output naming the revision a deploy created.

fqdnOutput.description: Output with that revision's address, the probe target.

revisionKey.description: Key of a traffic item that names a revision.

latestKey.description: Key of a traffic item that means the latest revision.

weightKey.description: Key of a traffic item's weight.

template.description: Template reference, relative to the catalog's templates directory.

kind.description: create (default) or grant. Grants are surfaced in the approval diff.

config.description: Template configuration. Values are any YAML scalar or map, kept as written.
